name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: She agrees to meet him for coffee after the final session, making it clear she will need to leave by 9 p.m.
reason: Ingrid has a history of making exceptions for one-on-one meetings with potential partners when the topic is relevant, and this conversation clearly aligns with her expansion and renovation interests. Her recent email exchange and his thoughtful questions make the invitation feel business-focused rather than purely social, while her narrow window before the night nurse arrives makes a time-limited acceptance the most practical response.
